name: local-issue-reporting-system
description: Monorepo for the Local Issue Reporting System (React frontend + Express/MongoDB backend)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:frontend
